_comment_execution_mode: Gunakan executionMode: demo|live. dryRun tetap didukung sebagai alias lama.
_comment_v5_strategy_presets: Available: scalp (default), conservative, aggressive, sniper, recovery, day_phase_swing. Switch via Telegram /strategy <id> or dashboard. Persisted in active-strategy.json.
_comment_strategy_evolution: When strategyEvolutionEnabled=true, the engine auto-produces and gates new strategy variants based on backtest+paper+live evidence. runtimeSelectorMode=shadow logs diffs only; =live applies evolved overrides.
_comment_v4_confirm_mode: When true, every BUY needs Telegram /yes <id> approval. confirmTtlMin = how long a pending intent stays valid (default 5 min).
_comment_multi_wallet: Aktifkan via dashboard wizard Step 12. Private key disimpan di .env sebagai WALLET_KEY_1..10 (jangan di file ini). Total capital_pct harus 100.
_comment_l0_security: Layer 0 tools — all zero or near-zero cost. Recommended: all enabled.
_comment_rugLLMEnabled: LLM rug analysis costs API credits. Enable only after accumulating 10+ known rugs.
_comment_day_phase: Weekend swing trade screener for 3-7 day holds. Requires >=1 SOL wallet balance.
_comment_staged_entry: DCA multi-buy instead of single-shot. trigger: price=dip-based, time=interval-based.
_comment_strategy_evolution_settings: Runtime selector mode: shadow (log only) or live (apply evolved rules).
